messages.author: 03082f3d9064040b
messages.subject: calling temporary files in R
parts:
Hello everybody,

I am new in using rApache and I am not sure, if it is okay to ask this
here or if I should use a more general group, but maybe you can help
me:

In my application I am using a jquery file uploading and then I want
to use this file in an R script.

I am looking for something which is equivalent to the PHP-call:
$handle = fopen($_FILES['userfile']['tmp_name'], "r");

Untill now I am only able to open the file, if it is in the localhost
folder (/var/www), but I dont know how to get to the temporary file
order. Using tempfile() did not work ...

I would be thankful if someone could help me. :)

Saramis

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: calling temporary files in R
parts:
Hi Saramis,

You can certainly do this. See section 5.4 of the manual which
explains how to access the files that you upload:

http://www.rapache.net/manual.html#rapache_Variables

Jeff
